name: Advent of Code interactive language notebook

mentions.name: Advent of Code interactive language notebook
mentions.description: A personal compiler/language used to work through Advent of Code puzzles, running interactively in a blog post. Still early-stage with compiler bugs, it is intended to grow into larger notebooks in the style of explorable explanations.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working through advent of code using my own little compiler/language. It's in such an early state that some creative problem solving is required, not to mention the compiler bugs! But I'm very pleased to have it running interactively on my blog like this – I want to work towards some bigger notebooks in the style of explorable explanations.
